name: Tomik Vrona
description: Teysa's apprentice who kept her informed and later managed the guild's daily affairs.

description_citations.text: "Teysa Karlov". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tomik brings back Hekara's corpse and she is revived as a bloodwitch; she beats Exava in a fight and agrees to help Kaya's group.
timeline.quote: Exava tried to object but lost to Hekara in a fight.

citation.text: "Cult of Rakdos", section "Guilds of Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tomik Vrona delivers Hekara's corpse to the Jester's Crypt where she is resurrected as a blood witch.
timeline.quote: where she was resurrected into a blood witch

citation.text: "Rix Maadi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya, sent by Bolas, infiltrates the catacombs and kills Grandfather Karlov and the Obzedat, becoming the new Orzhov leader; Teysa is reinstated as leading oligarch.
timeline.quote: Kaya infiltrated the catacombs and killed Grandfather Karlov and all other members of the Obzedat.

citation.text: "Teysa Karlov", section "Awaiting her time". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya turns the tables, has Teysa arrested and offers the hierarchs a deal.
timeline.quote: She turned the tables, had Teysa arrested, and offered the hierarchs a deal

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya turns the tables on the hierarchs, has Teysa arrested and offers them a deal.
timeline.quote: She turned the tables, had Teysa arrested, and offered the hierarchs a deal.

citation.text: "Orzhov Syndicate", section "Internal struggle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya frees bound ghosts from debt against Teysa's warning; the hierarchs pressure Teysa to arrest her but Tomik helps Kaya, and Teysa is arrested.
timeline.quote: Teysa was then arrested.

citation.text: "Teysa Karlov", section "Staging another coup". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rat, Teyo and Kaya meet the Orzhov triumvirate, and Bilagru convinces them to join the fight against Bolas.
timeline.quote: the triumvirate agreed to have the Orzhov Syndicate join the fight

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Rix Maadi, Tomik brings Hekara's corpse, the cultists resurrect her as a blood witch, and she defeats Exava and leads the Rakdos against Bolas.
timeline.quote: the Rakdos cultists resurrected Hekara as a blood witch

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Orzhov triumvirate agrees to join the fight against Bolas.
timeline.quote: Swayed by Bilagru's arguments, the triumvirate agreed to have the Orzhov Syndicate join the fight

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Rakdos resurrect Hekara as a blood witch.
timeline.quote: the Rakdos cultists resurrected Hekara as a blood witch

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Power over the Syndicate falls to Teysa and the Triumvirate while Kaya is distracted.
timeline.quote: With Kaya distracted, the actual power over the Syndicate fell to Matriarch Teysa Karlov and the Triumvirate

citation.text: "Orzhov Syndicate", section "After the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tomik finds a loophole letting Kaya temporarily transfer her contracts and guild duties to him, making him acting guildmaster.
timeline.quote: However, Tomik Vrona discovered a legal loophole that allowed Kaya to temporarily transfer her Orzhov contracts and guild responsibilities to him.

citation.text: "Orzhov Syndicate", section "After the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hekara is revived as a bloodwitch and goes to help Kaya's group; Rakdos does not stop her.
timeline.quote: Hekara's corpse was brought back by Tomik and she was revived as a bloodwitch.

citation.text: "Rakdos (character)", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tomik reunites with Ral and Hekara is resurrected as a blood witch to lead the Rakdos against Bolas.
timeline.quote: the Rakdos cultists resurrected Hekara as a blood witch

citation.text: "Ral Zarek", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the battle, Ral and Tomik reunite and kiss; Ral volunteers to capture Tezzeret as penance.
timeline.quote: Ral volunteered to capture Tezzeret as his penance.

citation.text: "Ral Zarek", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Maree calls a vote of no confidence but Ral keeps his position; he and Tomik later marry.
timeline.quote: Ral and Tomik were married during the springtime on Ravnica.

citation.text: "Ral Zarek", section "Confrontation with Tezzeret". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tomik Vrona arrives with an Orzhov thrull carrying Hekara's corpse and returns her to her people.
timeline.quote: I have brought Hekara back to her people.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Exava and six blood witches dress Hekara's body in rags and bells and send it with the thrull into the Jester's Crypt, where the thrull is killed.
timeline.quote: Have your thrull take Hekara into the Jester's Crypt.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Vrona reveals he serves Kaya as the true Orzhov guildmaster and that he sent the giant Bilagru to rally Orzhov troops.
timeline.quote: I am executive assistant to the true guildmaster of the Orzhov.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Tomik finds a loophole letting Kaya transfer her Orzhov contracts to him so she can planeswalk.
timeline.quote: Tomik Vrona discovered a legal loophole that allowed Kaya to temporarily transfer her Orzhov contracts and guild responsibilities to him

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "The hunt for Liliana". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the War of the Spark, Lazav partners with Teysa Karlov to control the Orzhov, has Dovin Baan killed to blackmail Vraska, and partners with Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: Lazav had Dovin Baan killed, which allowed the shapeshifter to blackmail Vraska

citation.text: "Lazav", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska sees Ral Zarek and Tomik Vrona flying over Ravnica and feels jealousy.
timeline.quote: Ral Zarek and Tomik Vrona approach, flying close on the back of a gargoyle.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Two days after the invasion, Ral learns that an officer found no sign of Vraska's body after his haemalectric switch worked.
timeline.quote: "There's no sign of her body, sir."

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Ral, back on Ravnica, vows to kill Jace for hiding as Ashiok and stealing a creature, and tells Tomik his plan to seek help.
timeline.quote: Beleren is alive, and I'm going to kill him.

citation.work: Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley
citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 1: Calamity Comes to Valley" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: On the dandelion shortcut, Ral tells Mabel he misses his husband Tomik.
timeline.quote: "I miss my husband, too."

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 4: Soothsaying and Stormcalling" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2024.

timeline.summary: Mabel gives Ral two holly-leaf buttons for him and his husband, and Ral vanishes in lightning.
timeline.quote: Ral vanished in an explosion of lightning sparks that lit the evening

citation.text: "Bloomburrow | Episode 5: Nightfall in Fountainport" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jul 2024.

relations.note: They grip hands and Tomik sits with Ral
relations.quote: Even from this distance I see them grip hands

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

relations.quote: since apparently the presence of my spouse will keep me from behaving in what he called an 'unreasonably reckless' manner.

relations.quote: Ral pressed a kiss to his husband's mouth to silence him.
